hwe_bench.problem_statement: Observed behavior: Rocket Chip can compute the Tile input widths for HartID (the per-hart identifier) and ResetVector (the tile boot address) incorrectly. When a design elaborates and connects per-tile HartID and reset-vector values, especially in a heterogeneous tile configuration, elaboration can fail because the Tile ports are narrower than the supplied signals. Expected behavior: the Tile-facing HartID and ResetVector ports should use the full configured widths, so those connections are width-correct and heterogeneous tile configurations elaborate successfully. Affected function: HartID/ResetVector width calculation for signals entering a Tile. Trigger condition: elaborating a configuration that propagates HartID and reset-vector values into one or more tiles, particularly when different tile types are present.

reduction.limitations: Reauthored interface and minimal environment isolate one contract; this does not reproduce upstream integration, performance, or full regression behavior.
reduction.preserved_contract: Preserve the full 16-bit HartID and full 48-bit reset vector on the corresponding Tile-facing outputs.
reduction.preserved_mechanism: Tile HartID and reset-vector ports could be narrower than the configured values in heterogeneous elaborations.

upstream.title: HartId/ResetVector: Correct the input width calculation
